feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR Politics for nonpartisan coverage of government, elections, policy debates and voting rights. Plus weekday audio from The NPR Politics Podcast.

entry.title: Justice Department issues subpoenas to California election workers
entry.summary: Grand jury subpoenas sent to election workers in Los Angeles come amid escalating tensions between the Trump administration and California election officials over the state's voter rolls.

entry.title: Trump returns to South Carolina as Senate race tightens
entry.summary: President Trump returned to South Carolina - the second time in eight days. The amount of attention and money its U.S. Senate race is getting is raising questions about how red the state really is.

entry.title: Alaska's all-important Senate race is roiled by a report on alleged spoiler candidate
entry.summary: New reporting alleging Democratic efforts to prop up a spoiler candidate has roiled Alaska's all-important U.S. Senate race.

entry.title: On the campaign trail, Trump delivers his greatest political hits and mourns end of rallies
entry.summary: President Trump is campaigning hard in the midterms. Supporters are showing up, in part because this could be the last chance to see him holding the large rallies that have been his trademark.

entry.title: Some rural Republicans in California say redistricting has left them without a voice
entry.summary: California's far northeastern corner used to be a reliably red congressional district. But Proposition 50 carved it up, meaning many voters there may soon have a Democrat representing them in D.C.

entry.title: Fishing is a key issue in Alaska's tight U.S. Senate race
entry.summary: Alaska's U.S. Senate race is embroiled in an emotional fight over fish. Many in the state rely upon salmon to feed their families but those fish and others are increasingly hard to find.

entry.title: GDP report to give insight before Election Day. And, Israel's election is deadlocked
entry.summary: Economists expect the GDP report to show economic growth, but say that growth is "fragile." And, after 90% of the votes in Israel have been counted, no clear winner has emerged.

entry.title: State ballots let voters decide on abortion, taxes, transgender restrictions
entry.summary: Missouri voters could ban abortion - after they just removed a ban two years ago. California voters could tax billionaires 5% of their wealth.

entry.title: These are the House races to watch in the 2026 midterm election on Nov. 3
entry.summary: An NPR analysis finds 70 House districts where Democrats and Republicans are each investing more than six figures in advertising during the final few days of the election, including in deep red areas.

entry.title: Support for Trump among white evangelicals has plummeted, polls reveal
entry.summary: Three new polls suggest that President Trump is losing ground among white evangelicals. What explains this drop — and will it affect the midterm elections?
